title: 灰色の咆哮：雲海を駆ける獣たちの挽歌
author: 狗飼 ハヤテ

en.title: The Gray Roar: The Elegy of Beasts Racing Through the Cloud Sea
en.premise: On the battered ship Hound, where diverse species stand shoulder‑to‑shoulder, a lost AI with no memories stumbles aboard one day. Driven by a map that promises a way from beneath the cloud sea to a forgotten land, the upper‑tier birdfolk and lower‑tier beastfolk clash—only to ultimately join forces. Crossing the walls of race, they chase the world’s truth, recording the souls of those who seek it.

zh.title: 灰色咆哮：云海奔腾的兽之挽歌
zh.premise: 在废弃的猎犬号船上，不同种族肩并肩，某天，一台失忆的迷失人工智能（AI）闯进来。它手握一张“云海之下，通往失落大地的地图”，引发上层鸟人族与下层兽人族的冲突，最终他们携手并肩。跨越种族壁垒，追寻世界真相的他们，记录下灵魂的足迹。
